limitations: The final gold and explicit-local cases were run once; the corporate held-out required one documented full-chain recovery run after an empty structured map.
The content-world chain took 79.3 to 108.776 seconds in successful final-package runs and consumed 13262 to 17047 total tokens per run.
The explicit-local run preserved its business and local map paths but still selected the broader preferred root, so soft-prior strength is not yet calibrated across industries.
This evidence covers content-root and map behavior, not production, publication, or outcome learning.
The agent-owned golden-gift and corporate held-out runs each passed once in a fresh thread; they do not establish repeated-run stability.
Version 1.3.4 passed one isolated held-out and one active-package golden full-Agent run. It does not establish every gift subcategory or eliminate model variance.
The active golden still appended platform, format, duration, cadence, and an invitation after completing the requested direction; this remains a generic Agent-kernel limitation.
The held-out run used one tool_search round before read_file, so progressive Skill loading still has avoidable retrieval overhead.
A complete fruit-shop prompt still produced a generic operational playbook without tools, so routing autonomy alone does not solve base-model marketing quality.
